zh.title: 中華航空桃園往返香港航班10月25日起移至第二航廈　報到、出入境及行李提領同步調整
zh.summary: 自2026年10月25日起，華航桃園往返香港航班改於第二航廈營運，旅客報到、出入境及行李提領同步移至第二航廈辦理。
body: 中華航空公告，自2026年10月25日起，往返臺灣桃園國際機場（TPE）與香港國際機場（HKG）的華航航班，將改於桃園機場第二航廈（T2）營運，旅客報到、出入境及行李提領等相關作業同步移至第二航廈辦理。華航已於9月10日在官網發布相關通知。
依照調整安排，搭乘華航桃園飛往香港航班的旅客，自生效日起須前往第二航廈辦理報到及出境手續；搭乘香港飛往桃園航班的旅客，抵達後則在第二航廈辦理入境及提領託運行李。接送親友也應依航班使用航廈調整接送地點。
華航在桃園機場依航線使用不同航廈。根據官網機場服務資訊，第二航廈目前服務飛往美國、加拿大、澳洲、紐西蘭、日本及中國大陸的華航航班，香港航線將自10月25日起納入第二航廈服務範圍。
華航提醒旅客，出發前應再次確認航班與航廈資訊，實際安排以官網最新公告為準。行程橫跨10月25日調整日期的旅客，應分別確認去程與回程所使用的航廈，以安排機場交通及接送。

en.title: China Airlines Taoyuan–Hong Kong Flights Move to Terminal 2 From October 25
en.summary: China Airlines flights between Taoyuan and Hong Kong will use Terminal 2 at Taoyuan Airport from October 25, 2026, including check-in, immigration and baggage claim.
body: China Airlines has announced that its flights between Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) and Hong Kong International Airport (HKG) will operate from Terminal 2 (T2) at Taoyuan Airport from October 25, 2026. Passenger check-in, departure and arrival immigration procedures, and baggage claim will also move to Terminal 2. The airline published the notice on its website on September 10.

From the effective date, passengers departing Taoyuan for Hong Kong on China Airlines must go to Terminal 2 for check-in and departure formalities. Passengers arriving from Hong Kong will complete arrival formalities and collect checked baggage in Terminal 2. People picking up or dropping off passengers should also adjust their meeting locations according to the terminal used by the flight.

China Airlines uses different terminals at Taoyuan Airport depending on the route. According to the airline's airport service information, Terminal 2 currently handles its flights to the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Japan and mainland China. Hong Kong services will be added to Terminal 2 from October 25.

China Airlines advises passengers to confirm flight and terminal information before departure, with arrangements subject to the latest announcements on its website. Passengers whose outbound and return journeys fall on either side of October 25 should check the terminal for each flight separately when planning airport transport and pick-up or drop-off arrangements.
